title: Docker Desktop and Docker Engine Configuration knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Docker Desktop and Docker Engine Configuration”?
options: Use a host CPU percentage as a universal performance measurement without context.
Measure a repeatable baseline and change one limit or variable at a time.
Assume resource limits improve every workload automatically.
questions.answer_key: Measure a repeatable baseline and change one limit or variable at a time.
questions.explanation: Resource tuning is workload- and platform-dependent; compare measured behavior instead of assuming a setting is beneficial.

questions.prompt: For a lab covering docker desktop and docker engine configuration, what is the strongest evidence of learning?
options: Use a production host so the result looks realistic.
Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
Assume the command is portable and skip reading its output.
Make several unrelated changes before collecting a baseline.
questions.answer_key: Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
questions.explanation: A useful lab connects a predicted result to actual output and checks an edge case. This is safer and more reproducible than assuming success.

questions.prompt: If an example related to docker desktop and docker engine configuration fails, which response is best?
options: Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
Delete every stopped container and unused volume before investigating.
Disable permissions or security controls until the example works.
Trust the image tag without inspecting the image or version.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
questions.explanation: The evidence-led approach keeps the diagnosis reproducible and avoids hiding the cause. For docker desktop and docker engine configuration, verify the fix with the exact setting or command that failed.
